ModMetaData.name: Yayo Auto-Reload (Standalone)
ModMetaData.author: Snat
ModMetaData.description:
Standalone auto-reload fix for Yayo's Combat 3, replacing the broken "Auto Reload Regression Fix" mod (disable that one if both are enabled, it fails to apply its patches).
Restores the Addon 1.6.10 auto-reload trigger (reload right after the last round is fired), adds a periodic empty-weapon reload retry for undrafted pawns including mechs, and routes mech refills through a virtual reload that spawns no physical ammo. Does not modify any other mod. Load after Harmony, Yayo's Combat 3 (Continued), and the Addon.
